format: Continuous CDP browser sampling at five frames/second; no cuts or scene retiming; local source service then retained production report; captions and synthesized narration

events.title: Squali · Source control for parallel agents
events.caption: Continuous local demonstration of the real source service. Production evidence is separate.

events.title: 01 / Fetch the source a task needs
events.caption: An authenticated path query needs no clone. Immutable identities support reusable caches.

events.title: 02 / Independent changes, exact review
events.caption: Concurrent API writes preserve intent, dependencies and agent-reported evidence.

events.title: 03 / Publish a selected set
events.caption: Keep approved work pending while landing a compatible subset with one main update.

events.title: 04 / Resolve conflicts explicitly
events.caption: A conflicting batch stops. The resolution retains context and requires fresh review.

events.title: 05 / Query history and protect meaning
events.caption: Indexed history and blame; parser-backed constraints for explicitly supported changes.

events.title: 06 / Keep the cost visible and bounded
events.caption: Persistent admission, finite attempts, reusable checkpoints, no hidden full reruns.

events.title: 07 / Evidence before submission
events.caption: Retained production verification; full object/ref identity, native Git fsck, explicit limits.
